claims.quote: Measurements: 0 = soil moisture percentage (SMP%) / 1 = soil temperature (degrees Celsius) / 2 = raw frequency measurement (Megahertz)
claims.derived_rule: Command index maps: M0/M = soil moisture %, M1 = soil temperature degC, M2 = raw frequency MHz. Page does not write the letters 'aM!' - mapping to M/M1/M2 is an inference (the numbered 'Measurements' list).
claims.limitation: Marketing spec table, not a command reference. Does not say whether the numbers are M-command indices, nor the D-block layout, nor whether output is per-sensor or interleaved. Product marked 'latest' in 2016; current firmware unknown.

claims.quote: Data points: One per 10cm sensor 'segment' in the probe. Probes are supplied in various lengths / number of sensors
claims.derived_rule: One value per sensor per measurement command.
claims.limitation: Contradicted in spirit by product list where 1000 mm has 3/5/10 sensors (not 10 cm pitch for 3 or 5 sensors); 'segment' undefined. Order of values (shallow-first or deep-first) not stated.

claims.quote: Bus address: Default = 0, can be changed using SDI-12 commands
claims.derived_rule: Factory address 0; changeable via standard SDI-12 aAb!.
claims.limitation: Only claim; no transcript. Banner note says most probes ship at 0 but radio defaults to ASCII '1' (S1 p1).

claims.quote: Sampling time: Approximately 300mS ... Settling time 250mS ... Voltage 5V - 24 VDC ... Current - idle TBA ... measurement 30mA
claims.derived_rule: Expect short ttt (~0-1 s); supply 5-24 VDC; 30 mA during measurement (2016). Idle current TBA in 2016; '6 mA' in 2017 (S4).
claims.limitation: 'Sampling time' is not an SDI-12 ttt declaration. No warm-up statement beyond 'settling time 250 mS'. S4 changes sensor max 10 -> 8 and idle TBA -> 6 mA, so spec revised over time.

claims.quote: Firmware upgrades: Yes, via SDI-12 interface
claims.derived_rule: Firmware versions may exist in the field; behaviour may differ.
claims.limitation: No firmware version list anywhere found.

claims.locator: Wayback 20170702 product page, 'It comes standard with' and 'Sensors'
claims.quote: 5 sensors (up to 8) ... Sensors | 1 to 8 ... Length | 100mm - 1500mm ... Diameter 38mm ... Cable Length Standard 3-core 5m, but up to 25m on request. Connector Bare Wire Cable
claims.derived_rule: Sensor count 1..8 (2017) vs 1..10 (2016); 3-core cable (power, ground, data).
claims.limitation: 2016 page (S2) says 'up to 10'.

claims.quote: HydraSCOUT - HD (SDI-12) 1500mm, 10 sensor, 5m cable | HydraSCOUT (SDI-12) 1500mm, 5 sensor, 5m cable | HydraSCOUT - budget (SDI-12) 1000mm, 3 sensor, 5m cable | HydraSCOUT (SDI-12) 200mm, 2 sensor, 5m cable
claims.limitation: Webshop catalogue (2020-2022); not a datasheet; depths/spacing per model not given. Whether Budget/Standard/HD differ in command set unknown. The 10-sensor HD exceeds the 9-value M limit of SDI-12; how HSTI packs 10 values is unknown.

claims.quote: From 2 to 8 sensors, installed at depths ranging from 20 to 150 cm. ... accuracy of +-3.0% volumetric water content (VWC) and +-0.5 C for temperature.
claims.derived_rule: Current marketing: moisture reported as VWC; temperature degC.
claims.limitation: Marketing page, no protocol content. 'VWC' here may be after Odusol calibration, not the SDI-12 raw output. No salinity on the 2026 page.

claims.quote: We are also developing salinity measurements at the request of certain customers
claims.derived_rule: Salinity is NOT a standard SDI-12 quantity in the 2016-2017 spec. 2021 home page claims 'humidite, temperature et salinite'; 2022 page says salinity 'in development'; install steps say chart per sensor of 'temperature, un index d'humidite et selon les cas de salinite' (S6).
claims.limitation: Moisture described as 'un index d'humidite' (an index), not necessarily VWC. Conductivity semantics, unit and command unknown.

claims.locator: centre-aide, 'What type of connection does it use?'
claims.quote: The unit is compatible with standard protocols (SDI-12, RS485) for connecting to probes.
claims.derived_rule: Refers to the datalogger (HydraConnect), not the probe's command set.
claims.limitation: No command content.

claims.quote: Specification www.sdi-12.org
claims.derived_rule: Probe claims conformance to published SDI-12 (version not stated).
claims.limitation: Version (1.3/1.4) not stated; so C/R/D-block/CRC support unknown.

claims.locator: p1 'Configuring...' and p2 'Example - Five HydraScout HSTI Probes to One Radio'
claims.quote: set the values in the enabling registers to M! (typically, soil moisture is the first result back from the probe and is located in the M! command position - verify this with the probe manufacturer's documentation)
claims.derived_rule: Banner's expectation: aM! = soil moisture. Banner itself defers to the manufacturer.
claims.limitation: Hedged ('typically', 'verify'). Not evidence of HSTI behaviour; the sentence is shared boilerplate with the Aquacheck note (S12: 'verify this with the probe manufacturer's documentation').

claims.locator: p4 'Example - One HydraScout Probe to One Radios'
claims.quote: the probe only reports back soil moisture and temperature readings using the aM! and aM! commands
claims.derived_rule: Intended: aM! and aM1! (see notes, typo). M! = Soil Moisture, M1! = Temperature (row labels).
claims.limitation: Typo: the two commands are written identically; the table rows on the same page show M! and M1!. Only M!/M1! appear; M2! (raw frequency, S2) is not mentioned. Banner's M! example is for a 3-sensor probe at address 1.

claims.locator: p4 table 'Probe Address 1 | M! | Soil Moisture | #1, 1-3 | 1 | 1.1234 | 0.02' and 'M1! | Temperature | #1, 1-3 | 1 | 1.1234 | 0.02'
claims.derived_rule: Table shows three values per command for 3 sensors. Values are placeholders: identical for moisture and temperature, and identical to the placeholder rows in Banner's Aquacheck (b_4182041: '1 1.1234 0.02 0.1234 0 0.1234', '24.994 24.528 24.98') and Decagon GS3 (b_4182043: 'WC, EC, Temp C ... 1 1.1234 0.02') notes.
claims.limitation: Not measurements. Units, ordering and scaling cannot be read from them. p3 uses '001.0000 001.1234 000.0200' and '24.99402 24.52802 24.97996' placeholders.

claims.locator: p4 Figure 1 (DXM Configurator Register View, slave 12, start 11101)
claims.derived_rule: Decoding as big-endian IEEE-754 (upper word first): 24.4924, 19.3029, 25.4817. This is the only apparently real reading in the note.
claims.limitation: Screenshot of unknown command, unknown installation, no D-block text. 3 values = 3 sensors. Cannot tell whether moisture % or temperature degC (both plausible); decode and word order are my inference. Not a transcript.

claims.quote: When both soil moisture and temperature data is required from each of the five probes, you must use more than one M-H12 radio.
claims.derived_rule: Banner radio limitation, not probe behaviour.
claims.limitation: Says nothing about probe.

claims.locator: p1 'For each of the five probes ... results registers' and p1 'Only results registers 1 through 9 are enabled since Mx! commands only support nine results.'
claims.quote: Only results registers 1 through 9 are enabled since Mx! commands only support nine results.
claims.derived_rule: Standard SDI-12 limit for M (9 values); relevant to 10-sensor HD (a single M cannot carry 10 values).
claims.limitation: Same note also says 'The M-H12 can measure up to 12 soil moisture points per probe' (p2) - internally inconsistent; the radio exposes 12 result slots, up to 24 by registers.

claims.locator: p6 'Supported M! Commands' / 'Supported C! Commands' tables
claims.derived_rule: These are radio register codes (which command the radio issues), not statements about the probe.
claims.limitation: Do not read as probe capabilities. C commands are only claimed as a radio feature.

claims.quote: Most manufacturers ship their sensor/probe units with an address of 0. The DX80DR9M-H12 radios are, by default, set to communicate with SDI-12 address 1 because address 0 is reserved as a broadcast method. / The default device addresses 49 through 53 are in ASCII.
claims.derived_rule: Radio default address '1' (ASCII 49). The 'address 0 reserved as a broadcast' claim is Banner's and contradicts SDI-12 (0 is the default, '?' is the wildcard).
claims.limitation: Banner's statement, not probe's.

claims.quote: DC+ = Brown (SP1) / DC- = Green/Yellow (GND) / Data = Blue (SDI)
claims.derived_rule: Probe cable colours 3-core: brown +, green/yellow GND, blue data.
claims.limitation: Colours stated by Banner for 'the sensor', only HydraScout-labelled in the note title. HSTI says 3-core cable (S4).

claims.quote: Warmup Time 1755 (50) / Sample Low 1753 (22500) / Voltage 1756 (148)
claims.derived_rule: Radio defaults. Not probe warm-up.
claims.limitation: Units not stated in note; do not treat as probe parameters.

claims.quote: Measurements | 0 = soil moisture percentage (SMP%) / 1 = soil temperature (degrees Celsius) / 2 = raw frequency measurement (Megahertz) ... Sensors | 1 to 8
claims.derived_rule: Verbatim copy of HSTI 2017 spec (S4); not independent confirmation.
claims.limitation: Copy; listing says 'Address: France'.

claims.quote: HSTI: HydraSCOUT multi-sensor soil moisture and temperature probe (Thanks Bertrand!)
claims.derived_rule: A third party reports the probe was tested with an SDI-12 USB adapter. No transcript published in the blog.
claims.limitation: No commands or replies shown; a one-line mention only.

claims.quote: HydraConnect is a datalogger that collects and transmits data from our HydraScout and HydraSolo probes. ... 15-minute intervals
claims.derived_rule: HSTI's own datalogger polls the probes; its SDI-12 command sequence is not published.
claims.limitation: Distributor text copied from HSTI; no protocol detail.

claims.quote: (search-engine snippets) HydraSCOUT 'SDI-12 commands M1!'
claims.derived_rule: A WebSearch summary asserted 'aM! and M1! are used with HydraScout'; that summary only restates the Banner PDF (S1).
claims.limitation: Not an independent source. Treated as non-evidence.

transcripts.notes: NOT a wire transcript. Banner never prints an SDI-12 reply string (no a<ttt><n>, no D0! line). The rows are Modbus-register presentations of radio results. Figure 1 registers 11101-11106 = 16835,61540,16794,27755,16843,55961 decode to 24.4924, 19.3029, 25.4817.

unknowns.question: What is the exact aI! response string (SDI-12 version, vendor, model, firmware, serial)?
unknowns.why_it_matters: Needed to recognise the probe and distinguish Budget/Standard/HD and firmware.

unknowns.question: Does aM! return ttt and n, and what are they for 2..10 sensor models? What is n for 10-sensor HD (SDI-12 M is limited to 9 values)?
unknowns.why_it_matters: Defines the wait and the parse; HD may need C or more than one command.

unknowns.question: Which commands exist (M, M1, M2, M3.., C, C1.., R, X..) and what does each return? Is M2 = raw MHz and are M and M1 really moisture/temperature?
unknowns.why_it_matters: Only a 2016-2017 marketing list exists, not a command reference.

unknowns.question: Value order and grouping: one value per sensor shallow-to-deep or deep-to-shallow? Moisture and temperature interleaved or in separate commands? How are values split over D0..D9?
Units and scaling: is moisture VWC %, a relative index, or raw; temperature degC; is 'SMP%' calibrated? Any conversion needed (Odusol calibration)?
Salinity/conductivity: is any command available, in what unit/index, which model/firmware?
unknowns.why_it_matters: Hydrascout.co 2021 mentions salinity; 2022 says in development; 2016 spec has none.

unknowns.question: Sensor depth/spacing per model (Budget, Standard, HD; each length) and the depth of sensor #1 from the top.
unknowns.why_it_matters: Needed to assign depths to values; 'one per 10cm segment' vs 3-sensor 1 m budget conflict.

unknowns.question: Error / missing-sensor value (e.g. -9999, 0, NaN, no value)? Behaviour when a sensor is faulty?
Supply voltage min/typ, idle current (TBA in 2016; 6 mA in 2017), measurement current (30 mA), warm-up before first M!, minimum interval between measurements.
Is CRC (aMC!) supported? Is concurrent measurement (aC!) and aV! supported? SDI-12 version 1.3 or 1.4? Extended commands (calibration, factory)?
How are calibration options exposed (soil class, texture, user coefficients) - on the probe or only in Odusol?
unknowns.why_it_matters: Whether raw or calibrated values are on the bus.

unknowns.question: Is HydraScout based on or a rebrand of another probe? (No source states this; unknown.)
unknowns.why_it_matters: Only a stated relationship would let us reuse another protocol.
